answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The bridge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the voyage is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
